# `.github/workflows/`

**The GitHub Actions workflows: the slowest tier of the gate ladder, and the pull-request reviewer,
whose status GitHub's auto-merge waits for.** Each file's header is the authority on it. Where a
row here and a header disagree, the header wins and the row is corrected.

| File | What it is, or what it refuses |
|---|---|
| `verify.yml` | Every gate that reads only committed files, cheapest first. It runs on every pull request and every push to `main`, the push an auto-merge makes among them, and by hand. It trusts none of the faster tiers (`CLAUDE.md` § The gate ladder). Each job that runs a gate checks out the whole history, which `trace:check` walks, installs the toolchain `mise.toml` pins through `jdx/mise-action`, locked (`docs/decisions.md` § D-31), and runs `npm ci --ignore-scripts`. Its jobs are split so no pull request's code off the floor runs before a gate the floor holds (`docs/decisions.md` § D-55): `floor-gates` runs the gates that read the product, `product-gates` those that run it, `gates` every other, and `verify`, the check the trunk's ruleset requires, passes only when the three did. `pr-review:check` holds the split. |
| `pr-review.yml` | The pull-request reviewer (`docs/decisions.md` § D-47, amending § D-07, § D-37 and § D-46). On each head a pull request against `main` is given, `scripts/pr-review.mjs review` sets the `pr-review` status from the high-risk floor alone: off it, success, and GitHub's auto-merge merges the head once `verify` passes too; on it, failure, and a person merges it. It runs on `pull_request_target`, so the trunk's copy runs, and it reads the head only as git objects. Its one job holds `contents: read` and `statuses: write` and nothing else: it merges, labels, comments and dispatches nothing. No language model and no secret takes part, and it installs no npm package. It takes from `mise.toml`, through `jdx/mise-action`, only the tools it runs: Node and gh. It reads a token and the network, so it is no tier of the ladder: `pr-review:check` and `pr-review:selftest` hold its wiring and its decisions, at push and in `verify.yml`. |
